headline: 蜘蛛侠领跑周榜，小黄人今日热
headlineEn: Spider-Man tops weekly charts, Minions trends today
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周已累计6部新片。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑本周热度，《小黄人与大怪兽》成今日焦点；《逃出绝命街》等新作备受期待。
summaryEn: No new films today, but six opened this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day leads weekly buzz, while Minions and the Big Monster dominates today; upcoming titles like Escape from Dead End Street are highly anticipated.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片公映，市场进入本周新片口碑释放期
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today; the market digests this week's new titles.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有6部新片上映，暑期档供给稳定
industryHighlights.en: Six new films opened this week, keeping the summer slate steady.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》与《奥德赛》分列周榜前二
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Odyssey lead the weekly charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》已列入待映片单
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Dead End Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are upcoming releases.
